title: I made this to help support my comic and maybe even make a game. Think will it work?
author: xcantene
selftext:
Hi everyone! This is Glimp, from my mini webtoon *The Adventures of Glimp*.

I’ve been building a new website with Codex and Opus 5.5 to bring together the games, comics, and fantasy novels I’ve been creating over the past three years, including collaborations with other artists. I’m adding little interactions and minigames alongside the browser games to give people more to explore.

Things have been difficult since I lost my job. Before, I could fund the artwork and work with voice actors, but being unemployed has made continuing these projects... well impossible. 

For Glimp, I’ve made this interactive donation feature to appear at the bottom of episode 14, the latest episode I was able to create with a talented artist. The goal is to fund a much longer special episode to bring Glimp back, which is why the funding target is relatively high.

I drew this Glimp in Photoshop, separating the character into layers and creating different eyes and mouth shapes. Then I worked with Codex to animate him, directing the movements and interactions.

Do you think this kind of interactive feature could encourage readers to support the next episode? I’d appreciate honest feedback on how it feels and what could work better.
